referenceSources.description:
A pristine white 1991 Ford Escort RS Turbo Series 2 is showcased in a modern showroom, complete with twin rally lights mounted on the front bumper and five-spoke alloy wheels. The right-hand drive coupe’s manual five-speed gearbox and period-correct RS Turbo bodykit highlight its performance heritage. The illuminated “MZ” logo on the textured wall behind the car and the UK license plate H609 MWC reinforce its British provenance.

This rare example, located in Blackpool, United Kingdom, is offered for sale at £21,995. Enthusiasts will appreciate the clean presentation, original styling cues, and the opportunity to own a classic 1.6 RS Turbo in excellent condition.
